original.statement: The CLI flag `--endpoint-status` has been removed in Cilium 1.16.0.

decision.reason: [ev-f64f7c540c6d] says the flag `endpoint-status` has been removed in the 1.16 Upgrade Notes › Removed Options section. The canonical exposure for a removed CLI flag is cli-flag{--endpoint-status, set}, and that is what was proposed. The Helm upgrade notes the item points to are not in the evidence, so I cannot confirm whether a related values key should also be part of the condition. That is why confidence is low.
